summary: The Skills system is a hotbar-driven active-ability layer: 30 sacred skills (all buff/utility-style in skills-skills-1.JSON) plus test/generated skills that add tag-based combat abilities. SkillManager (entities/components/skill_manager.py, 1169 lines) owns known skills, 5 hotbar slots, cooldowns, mana gating, per-skill leveling (1-10, +10%/level), and dispatches either (a) a legacy buff pipeline that creates ActiveBuff objects on the character, or (b) a tag-based combat pipeline that hands combatTags+combatParams to the shared EffectExecutor. String enums (mana 'moderate', cooldown 'long', duration 'brief', magnitude 'major') are translated to numbers via TranslationDatabase, loaded from Definitions.JSON/skills-translation-table.JSON and Skills/skills-base-effects-1.JSON. Activation is keys 1-5 in GameEngine; the Skills menu (K) handles learn/equip/unequip. Mana pool = 100 base + 20/INT + class + equipment; regen = 1% of max per second. A separate SkillUnlockSystem (progression/skill-unlocks.JSON) handles trigger+cost unlocks parallel to the requirements-based learn flow.
player_facing: Keys 1-5 activate hotbar slots 0-4; each keypress captures mouse world position for aiming and calls use_skill (core/game_engine.py:974-1015)

Success/failure message shown as notification: green (150,255,150) on success, red (255,150,150) on failure — failures are 'Invalid slot' / 'No skill in slot' / 'On cooldown (X.Xs)' / 'Not enough mana (N required)' (core/game_engine.py:979-983; entities/components/skill_manager.py:199-222)
K toggles the Skills menu; closes other overlay panels (core/game_engine.py:878-887)

Skills menu: click a learned skill to auto-equip into the FIRST empty hotbar slot; click an equipped hotbar slot to unequip; click an available (learnable) skill to learn it; 'All hotbar slots full!' warning when no slot free (core/game_engine.py:3155-3193)

Hotbar UI: 5 slots of 60px, 10px spacing, bottom-center; slot key number top-left; skill icon (icon_path, fallback = first letters of first 2 name words); on cooldown → 180-alpha black overlay + red 'X.Xs' countdown text; off cooldown → 'NMP' mana cost bottom-left, blue (100,200,255) if affordable else red (255,100,100) (rendering/renderer.py:3240-3323)
Hovering a hotbar slot shows a 350x200 tooltip above the slot (rendering/renderer.py:3276-3349)
MP bar in HUD: width proportional to mana/max_mana with 'MP: cur/max' text (rendering/renderer.py:3190-3193)
Skill level-ups print/notify 'Used X! Level N!' (skill EXP: 100 per activation) (entities/components/skill_manager.py:257-262)
On character level-up, console lists up to 3 newly-available skills: 'N new skill(s) available! Check Skills menu (K)' (entities/character.py:1573-1588)
Unlock-with-cost skills print 'Pending payment - check Skills menu (K) to unlock' (entities/character.py:1611-1616)
Directional skills (beam/cone/line tag) print 'Aiming toward mouse cursor' and aim at cursor world pos (entities/components/skill_manager.py:963-970)
Skill kills: 'killed by skill!', +EXP, auto-loot into inventory (no loot in dungeons, 2x EXP there) (entities/components/skill_manager.py:1026-1049)
Debug F2 toggle: learn ALL skills (skip checks) + equip first 5; disable restores saved known/equipped state (core/game_engine.py:1049-1087)
Mouse-wheel scrolls the skills menu list (core/game_engine.py:1462-1463)
mechanics: LEARN: can_learn_skill checks already-known, skill exists, character level >= requirements.character_level, per-stat minimums via map {STR:strength, DEF:defense, VIT:vitality, LCK:luck, AGI:agility, INT:intelligence, DEX→agility}, and required title_ids in character.titles.earned_titles (entities/components/skill_manager.py:48-91)

learn_skill(skip_checks) creates PlayerSkill(level=1, exp=0), records stat_tracker.record_skill_learned(source='level'|'system'), publishes SKILL_LEARNED on event bus (entities/components/skill_manager.py:93-127)

UNLOCK (parallel path): SkillUnlockSystem.check_for_unlocks iterates skill-unlocks.JSON entries, filters by trigger (level_up/title_earned/quest_complete/activity_threshold + trigger_value), checks conditions; zero-cost → unlock immediately, has-cost+affordable → pending_unlocks awaiting player confirmation; unlock pays cost then adds to unlocked_skills (systems/skill_unlock_system.py:35-138); SkillManager.unlock_skill = learn_skill(skip_checks=True) (entities/components/skill_manager.py:129-142); triggers fired from character on level_up/title_earned (entities/character.py:1201-1224, 1590-1616)
EQUIP: equip_skill(skill_id, slot 0-4) sets equipped_skills[slot] and is_equipped=True; unequip clears both (entities/components/skill_manager.py:166-182)

MANA COST RESOLUTION: SkillDatabase.get_mana_cost — numeric passes through as int; string looked up in translation table {low:30, moderate:60, high:100, extreme:150}, default 60 for unknown string (data/databases/skill_db.py:206-211; Definitions.JSON/skills-translation-table.JSON manaCostTranslations)
COOLDOWN RESOLUTION: get_cooldown_seconds — numeric passes through as float; string {short:120, moderate:300, long:600, extreme:1200} seconds, default 300 (data/databases/skill_db.py:213-218)
DURATION RESOLUTION: get_duration_seconds {instant:0, brief:15, moderate:30, long:60, extended:120}, default 0 (data/databases/skill_db.py:220-222; data/databases/translation_db.py:28-30)

ACTIVATION PIPELINE (use_skill): validate slot → skill equipped → learned → definition exists → cooldown==0 → mana >= cost; then consume mana, start cooldown, apply effect, record stat_tracker.record_skill_used + publish SKILL_ACTIVATED, award 100 skill EXP (entities/components/skill_manager.py:190-262)
COOLDOWN TICK: update_cooldowns(dt) decrements each known skill's current_cooldown toward 0; called from Character.update (entities/components/skill_manager.py:184-188; entities/character.py:1460)

SKILL LEVELING: EXP to next level = 1000 * 2^(level-1), max level 10, overflow EXP carries and can multi-level; get_level_scaling_bonus = 0.1*(level-1), i.e. +0% at L1, +90% at L10 (data/models/skills.py:96-130)
BRANCH: if skill_def.combat_tags non-empty → combat path; else legacy buff path (entities/components/skill_manager.py:277-301)

COMBAT PATH (enemies present): target_enemy = available_enemies[0] (first, not nearest), sets combat_manager.player_in_combat=True (skills can initiate combat), then _apply_combat_skill_with_context (entities/components/skill_manager.py:280-295)

COMBAT SCALING: scaled_params = copy of combatParams; baseDamage and baseHealing each *= (1+level_bonus), then *= (1+class_affinity_bonus) as a second multiplication (entities/components/skill_manager.py:929-951)

COMBAT TARGET SELECTION: directional tags (beam/cone/line) + mouse pos → primary_target = mouse world pos, entities = enemies; effect.target=='enemy' → provided target_enemy; 'self' → character, entities=[character]; 'area' → first enemy (or mouse pos if directional); default self (entities/components/skill_manager.py:957-1001)

EFFECT HANDOFF: effect_executor.execute_effect(source=character, primary_target, tags=combat_tags, params=scaled_params, available_entities); returns context with .targets list (entities/components/skill_manager.py:1003-1016)

POST-EXECUTE: tag-driven visual via attack_effects manager keyed on geometry tag (circle→area ring at source|target per params.origin; cone→arc using cone_angle/cone_range; beam→thrust with beam_range; chain→segment lines+bursts between targets; single/pierce→slash arc 50° or thrust 15°) (entities/components/skill_manager.py:1055-1168)

KILL HANDLING: for each context target with is_alive==False → EXP via combat_manager._calculate_exp_reward (2x in dungeon), leveling.add_exp, generate_loot + inventory.add_item outside dungeons, on_dungeon_enemy_killed inside (entities/components/skill_manager.py:1023-1049)

COMBAT PATH (no enemies): _apply_combat_skill — target 'enemy' or 'area' prints warning and RETURNS WITHOUT EFFECT (mana/cooldown already spent); 'self' still executes with entities=[character] (entities/components/skill_manager.py:738-799)

BUFF PATH: duration = translated seconds; 'instant' (0s) → duration 60.0 + consume_on_use=True (consumed by next matching action); timed → duration * (1+level_bonus), consume_on_use=False (entities/components/skill_manager.py:304-325)

BUFF MAGNITUDE: value = magnitudeValues[effect_type][magnitude] (from Skills/skills-base-effects-1.JSON, default 0.5 if missing) scaled by (1 + level_bonus + class_affinity_bonus) ADDITIVELY (entities/components/skill_manager.py:327-334)

BUFF EFFECT TYPES: empower (+X% category damage), quicken (+X% speed), fortify (+X flat damage reduction, category forced to 'defense'), pierce (+X% crit chance), enrich (+N whole bonus items, int-truncated), elevate (+X% rarity upgrade chance), regenerate (X per-second restore, ALWAYS over-time: consume_on_use forced False, 60s if instant), transcend (bypass N tier restrictions, int) — each creates ActiveBuff(buff_id=f'{skill_id}_{type}') added to character.buffs (entities/components/skill_manager.py:341-593)

RESTORE (instant, no buff): durability category → repair ALL equipped items + axe/pickaxe tools by percent {minor:.15, moderate:.30, major:.50, extreme:.75} * (1+level_bonus), records repairs, publishes REPAIR_PERFORMED; health/defense category → flat heal {minor:50, moderate:100, major:200, extreme:400} clamped to max_health; mana category → same amounts to mana (entities/components/skill_manager.py:426-449, 680-736)

DEVASTATE: radius = int(magnitudeValue * (1+level+affinity)); if instant AND category in [damage, combat] AND combat_manager has execute_instant_player_aoe → immediate AoE, prints hit count; else creates consume-on-use/timed AoE buff (used by gathering Chain Harvest) (entities/components/skill_manager.py:519-572)

CLASS AFFINITY: get_skill_affinity_bonus = 5% per case-insensitive tag overlap between class tags and skill combat_tags (buff path falls back to [effect.category]), capped at 20% (data/models/classes.py:33-46; entities/components/skill_manager.py:311-316, 939-944)

MANA POOL: base_max_mana=100 (entities/character.py:114); max_mana = base + INT*20 (stats-calculations.JSON maxManaPerPoint, fallback 20.0 at entities/components/stats.py:29) + class max_mana bonus + equipment max_mana bonus (entities/character.py:722-723); on max change, current mana rescaled proportionally (entities/character.py:729-731)
MANA REGEN: +1% of max_mana per second, every update, clamped to max (entities/character.py:1453-1455)

FAILURE CASES: invalid slot / empty slot / not learned / no definition / current_cooldown>0 (message includes remaining seconds to 1 decimal) / mana < cost — all return (False, msg) BEFORE any resource is spent (entities/components/skill_manager.py:199-222)

DB LOADING: SkillDatabase singleton loads Skills/skills-skills-*.JSON (sacred) then skills-generated-*.JSON overlay (generated id wins), then Update-N skills re-merged; reload keeps previous state on failure (data/databases/skill_db.py:59-123); engine boots it at core/game_engine.py:175
PlayerSkill JSON parse: missing iconPath auto-generates 'skills/{skill_id}.png' (data/databases/skill_db.py:167-170)
data: Skills/skills-skills-1.JSON — 30 sacred skills; per skill: skillId, name, tier (1-4), rarity, categories[], description, narrative, tags[], effect{type, category, magnitude, target, duration, additionalEffects[]}, cost{mana, cooldown} (numeric in this file, e.g. 60/180), requirements{characterLevel, stats{STR:20,...}, titles[]}; examples: miners_fury (empower/mining/major/self/moderate, mana 60 cd 180), battle_stance (fortify/defense/major/self/long, req lvl3 DEF5), combat_strike (empower/damage/extreme/enemy/instant, mana 50 cd 30), bountiful_harvest (enrich/mining/moderate/resource_node/extended, req LCK5), whirlwind_strike (devastate/damage/moderate/area/instant, mana 140 cd 500, req STR20 AGI15), master_craftsman (empower/smithing/extreme + additionalEffects elevate)

Skills/skills-testing-integration.JSON — combat skills with combatTags/combatParams; meteor_strike: combatTags [fire, circle, burn, knockback], combatParams {baseDamage:150, circle_radius:8.0, origin:'target', burn_duration:12.0, burn_damage_per_second:10.0, knockback_distance:5.0}, cost {mana:'extreme', cooldown:'extreme'} (string tiers); chain_lightning: [lightning, chain, shock] {baseDamage:60, chain_count:5, chain_range:7.0, ...} mana 'high' cd 'long'

Definitions.JSON/skills-translation-table.JSON — manaCostTranslations {low:30, moderate:60, high:100, extreme:150}, cooldownTranslations {short:120, moderate:300, long:600, extreme:1200}, durationTranslations {instant:0, brief:15, moderate:30, long:60, extended:120}; also target/category compatibility tables (informational)

Skills/skills-base-effects-1.JSON — BASE_EFFECT_TYPES.<effect>.magnitudeValues: empower {minor:.5, moderate:1.0, major:2.0, extreme:4.0}, quicken {.3/.5/.75/1.0}, fortify {10/20/40/80}, enrich {1/3/6/12}, pierce {.1/.15/.25/.4}, restore {50/100/200/400}, regenerate {3/5/10/20}, elevate {.15/.25/.4/.6}, devastate {3/5/7/10}, transcend {1/2/3/4}
progression/skill-unlocks.JSON — unlock entries with trigger{type, trigger_value, message} and cost{gold, materials, skill_points} loaded via SkillUnlockDatabase (core/game_engine.py:176-177)
Definitions.JSON/stats-calculations.JSON — characterStatModifiers.intelligence.maxManaPerPoint (=> 20 mana/INT point) consumed by stats.py loader (entities/components/stats.py:80-83)
Update-N packages layer additional skills (e.g. Update-2 fishing) via load_all_updates / load_skill_updates (core/game_engine.py:180-182; data/databases/skill_db.py:108-123)
constants: Skill EXP curve = 1000 * 2^(level-1); max skill level 10 (data/models/skills.py:96-101)
Class affinity = 0.05 per matching tag, cap 0.20 (data/models/classes.py:43-46)
Mana tier map low/moderate/high/extreme = 30/60/100/150; unknown-string default 60 (data/databases/translation_db.py:26; data/databases/skill_db.py:211)
Cooldown tier map short/moderate/long/extreme = 120/300/600/1200 s; unknown-string default 300 (data/databases/translation_db.py:27; data/databases/skill_db.py:218)
Duration map instant/brief/moderate/long/extended = 0/15/30/60/120 s; unknown default 0 (data/databases/translation_db.py:28-30; data/databases/skill_db.py:222)
Instant-buff fallback duration = 60.0 s with consume_on_use=True (entities/components/skill_manager.py:320-322)
Magnitude default 0.5 when effect_type/magnitude missing from table (entities/components/skill_manager.py:334)
Restore durability percents minor/moderate/major/extreme = .15/.30/.50/.75; restore flat amounts = 50/100/200/400 (default 100) (entities/components/skill_manager.py:428-429, 433, 443)
Base max mana = 100 (entities/character.py:114); INT flat mana = +20/point (entities/components/stats.py:29); mana regen = 1% of max per second (entities/character.py:1454)
Max-mana formula: base + INT_flat + class_bonus + equip_bonus, current rescaled by old ratio (entities/character.py:722-731)
Gathering EXP on harvest by resource tier {1:10, 2:40, 3:160, 4:640} feeds level-up→skill availability checks (entities/character.py:1202, 1221)
Visual constants: single-target arc 50°, thrust/pierce arc 15°, radius 2.0; default circle_radius 3.0, cone_angle 60°, cone_range 3.0, beam_range 5.0 (entities/components/skill_manager.py:1099-1151)
Hotbar render: slot 60px, spacing 10px, cooldown overlay alpha 180 (rendering/renderer.py:3242-3306)
Magnitude/translation fallback constants duplicated for no-JSON environments (data/databases/translation_db.py:26-42; entities/components/skill_manager.py:41-46)
hazards: Mana + cooldown + 100 skill EXP are spent BEFORE the effect resolves; enemy/area-targeted combat skills with no enemies in range print a warning and do nothing but still consume everything (entities/components/skill_manager.py:224-262, 762-775) — preserve this cost-then-fizzle order

Buff path vs combat path scale affinity DIFFERENTLY: buff magnitudes use base*(1 + level + affinity) additive (skill_manager.py:328-329), combat params use base*(1+level)*(1+affinity) multiplicative (skill_manager.py:934-951) — do not unify

effect.additionalEffects is parsed into SkillEffect.additional_effects but NEVER executed at runtime (only tests construct it) — e.g. master_craftsman's elevate rider silently does nothing (data/databases/skill_db.py:140; no consumer in skill_manager.py)

use_skill_in_combat (skill_manager.py:801-913) is a complete duplicate entry point that is never called anywhere in the game — the live path is use_skill via keys 1-5; port only if you want the dead API too

Restore percents/amounts in _apply_skill_effect are HARDCODED (skill_manager.py:428-429) and do NOT read skills-base-effects-1.JSON, while _extract_skill_value for the SAME effect reads the JSON table (skill_manager.py:654-657) — stat-tracking value can diverge from actual heal
Primary combat target is available_enemies[0] — first in list, NOT nearest (skill_manager.py:285, 995); combat entered implicitly by skill use (player_in_combat=True, skill_manager.py:288-289)

Directional aiming only when BOTH a beam/cone/line tag is present AND mouse_world_pos was passed; the geometry visual check uses a different tag set ('circle','cone','beam','chain','pierce','single'/'single_target') than the aiming check ('beam','cone','line') (skill_manager.py:963-964, 1074-1079)

'instant' duration buffs become 60s consume_on_use buffs, consumed by BuffManager.consume_buffs_for_action matching action_type/category — they can expire unconsumed after 60s (skill_manager.py:320-322; entities/components/buffs.py:108-127)
regenerate forces consume_on_use=False always; when duration was instant it silently becomes a 60s HoT (skill_manager.py:497-507)
DEX in skill requirements maps to agility (skill_manager.py:77)

SkillCost.mana/cooldown are Union[str,int,float] — sacred file uses numerics, test/generated files use string tiers; both must be supported everywhere costs are read, including the hotbar renderer which re-resolves cost each frame (data/models/skills.py:24-26; rendering/renderer.py:3315)

Two learn paths coexist: requirements-based learn (menu click, can_learn_skill) and SkillUnlockSystem (trigger+cost, learn via skip_checks); SkillUnlockSystem state (unlocked_skills/pending_unlocks) is separate from SkillManager.known_skills (systems/skill_unlock_system.py:22-24)
F2 debug passes character=self (the GameEngine, not Character) to learn_skill — harmless only because skip_checks=True and GameEngine lacks stat_tracker (core/game_engine.py:1062)
Generated skills overlay sacred on id collision (generated wins), and reload must re-merge Update-N skills or fishing skills vanish mid-session (data/databases/skill_db.py:62-66, 108-123)
SkillDatabase.get_duration_seconds returns 0 for unknown keys → unknown duration string silently behaves as instant/consume-on-use (data/databases/skill_db.py:220-222)
equip via menu click always targets first EMPTY slot; no drag/reorder; menu hotbar unequip fires on any click on an occupied slot despite 'right-click' comment (core/game_engine.py:3160-3183)
Skill kill rewards are handled inside SkillManager (EXP, loot, dungeon wave notify) — duplicated from CombatManager's weapon-kill path; keep both in sync (skill_manager.py:1023-1049)

PlayerSkill.hotbar_slot field exists but the source of truth is SkillManager.equipped_skills list; is_equipped bool is maintained on equip/unequip (data/models/skills.py:87-88; skill_manager.py:166-182)
Buff-path 'quicken' and others print via bare print() while empower uses debug_print — cosmetic inconsistency, not load-bearing (skill_manager.py:357-381)
